subject.title: feat(ui): permanent OpenClaw presence — pinned sidebar entry and Settings dock

question: Should the planned permanent custodian surface ship as a default pin and first Settings entry once the normal-versus-onboarding welcome behavior is corrected?
rationale: The patch introduces a new first-run navigation default and Settings information architecture; the referenced redesign plan supports the direction, but the protected maintainer label requires an explicit owner decision on the shipped product surface.

options.title: Sponsor the planned permanent surface
options.body: Keep the default pin and Settings entry, require the welcome-mode repair and proof for both routes before merge.

options.title: Keep custodian discoverable without default pinning
options.body: Retain a Settings or More/customize entry but remove the fresh-profile default pin if maintainers do not want a new primary navigation default.

options.title: Pause Phase 6 navigation
options.body: Defer this UI surface until the broader onboarding redesign has a confirmed maintainer rollout decision.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the planned permanent surface
recommendation.body: Keep the default pin and Settings entry, require the welcome-mode repair and proof for both routes before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged and current work make steipete the clearest available owner for the custodian onboarding direction.
